Screen displays a PlayStation lock screen reading 'To unlock, press the PS button' with a battery icon, wifi icon, and time '5:13 PM'.
Photo 2 shows the rear/side profile of the device, plain white and black, no visible model number or serial plate legible.
No charging cable, box, or original packaging is visible in any photo.
Watermark 'MOBILELINKS GADGETS & COMS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlay all images; these are seller/platform marks, not proof of condition.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PS5 Portal handheld by its distinctive shape and PlayStation lock screen, so it can be priced; however, since no functional test (streaming, stick movement, screen brightness, battery) is shown, it must be priced at worst case as an unverified-working unit with no accessories confirmed.
